questions.question: Why did the team change its decision about the format of next year's customer summit?
questions.answer_text: It did not change. The team kept three one-day regional roadshows in Manchester, Frankfurt and Austin instead of one central event. Concerns raised: Ingrid objects that weak early response and a rising Frankfurt cost mean the roadshows could miss the 1.2 million dollar pipeline target that the event is measured on. Kofi reports that only 58 of the 140 target accounts have responded yes to the save-the-date, and the Frankfurt venue has re-quoted 22 percent higher. Why it stayed: Sofia answers that the save-the-date went out before executive invitations, which tripled responses last year, and that even with the Frankfurt increase the roadshows come in 61,000 dollars under the central event.
